programme.title: The Art of Hammering: Metal Ornament Master
programme.desc: Jangseok is metal ornaments attached to wooden furniture or structures to reinforce joints or to serve as locks. Enjoy observing the traditional process of making these brass ornaments, which enhance the completeness and design of wooden furniture. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Flowering Devotion: Shoe Making Master
programme.desc: Traditional Korean shoes, delicately stitched petal by petal, are more than footwear—they embody beauty, craftsmanship, and heartfelt wishes. Each step in their making reflects generations of devotion passed down through time. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Beauty of Golden Patterns. Gold Leaf Master
programme.desc: The technique of gold leaf, which enhances the beauty and elegance of Korean clothing, is a traditional art where thin gold leaves are applied to fabric to add beauty. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Ink with Soot: Ink Master
programme.desc: Ink, one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone), has been a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of the ink master. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.5
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Garden that Calms the Mind: Soswaewon Garden, Damyang
programme.desc: Created by Yang San-bo in Damyang, Soswaewon is a beautiful garden symbolizing the dignified character and integrity of Korean scholar-officials from the Joseon Dynasty. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Weaving with the Heart: Making a Cocculus Hat
programme.desc: The Jeongdong Beollip is a traditional hat woven from cocculus, a native vine of Jeju. Each evenly spaced strand reflects the artisan’s rhythm and refined touch. Feel the breeze of Jeju island through the delicate sound of weaving. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Crafting a Thousand-Year Sound: Making the Janggu
programme.desc: The janggu, an hourglass drum with different tones on each side, holds dual voices in one instrument. Shaped with wood, leather, and rope, it carries memories passed through generations. Listen to the rhythm where tradition breathes. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A World of Insight and Enlightenment: Painting Bodhidharma
programme.desc: Each stroke in a Dalma-do carries the spirit of Zen. Free from the confines of traditional Buddhist painting, this art reveals a world of silent discipline and spontaneous expression. Enter the breath between ink and emptiness. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ARO episode 226
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter ARO! ARO burst into the music scene in July 2018 with the single A Good Daughter. Her stage name means engraving in Korean which conveys her hope to engrave her name in the minds of the public. She's also known for her ability to express common relatable issues in her own unique way deeply touching and soothing listeners' hearts. Sentimental at times yet unpredictable at others she's definitely engraving her name in our hearts. In this episode ARO performs SEESAW When The Night Comes Day 1 Why Did You Answer? and also her cover of Delispice's Confession. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - PARKMOONCHI episode 227
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the hottest newtro master PARKMOONCHI! PARKMOONCHI became known to the public through the variety show Hangout with Yoo where she displayed her exceptional ability to put her own contemporary spin to 1990s music. That sensational appearance led her to actively collaborate with numerous big names in the music scene including Suho and Baekhyun from EXO Kang Daniel Kwon Jin Ah and Young K from Day6. Also known for her witty and unexpectional point of view PARKMOONCHI shares with everyone how the Generagion MZ enjoys the music and culture of older generations - no wonder how she became an icon of MZers. In September this year PARKMOONCHI released a new EP named ParkRuRa with RuRu and RaRa. Combining R&B new jack swing and soul music the three musicians also known as PARKMOONCHI UNIVERSE show off their unique yet beautiful universe under their motto Pursuing joy and happiness together In this episode PARKMOONCHI performs m e s s a g e . . . and Move! from the album ParkRuRa her cover of Lee Ye-rin's Come On Baby Tonight as well as I Want To Hold Your Hand and The Story Of The Year with Onewoo. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this delightful and unpredicted artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - BAEK A YEON episode 228
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is talented vocalist BAEK A YEON! Known for her crystal clear voice BAEK A YEON made her big debut in 2012 after making it to the top three of the popular talent search show K-Pop Star in 2011. Then she dominated the top spots of various music charts and shows with the song Shouldn't Have... which she wrote at the end of a disappointing relationship. After that she released more songs about love oftentimes unrequited love including Looking For Love and so-so which has eventually become her own genre. In this episode BAEK A YEON performs Shouldn't Have... so-so Sweet Lies a Good Boy Jealousy and 0% the lead single off her latest album Observe. Tune in to I'm LIVE and fall in love with her crystalline voice once again!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - eldon episode 229
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!
